name: DSH Flash 精简预设
description: Two DSH agent presets shipped as a dsh.bundle combo package: flash-lean-ptc-v3 (13 hard behavior rules plus the PTC tool surface, the default) and flash-lean-ptc-v3-balance (3 rules, looser). They tune per-turn round budgets, tool-output folding and the criteria for calling a task finished, to cut token spend on DeepSeek V4.1 Flash. Installs as a profile patch layer; a runtime alias layer keeps sessions created under older preset ids resolvable.
descriptionZh: 两个面向 flash 级路由的 DSH agent 预设，以 dsh.bundle 组合包形式安装：flash-lean-ptc-v3（13 条硬约束 + PTC 工具面，默认）与 flash-lean-ptc-v3-balance（3 条，约束更弱）。调整每轮轮数预算、工具输出折叠与「任务算完成」的判据，以降低 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 上的 token 消耗；安装方式是 profile 补丁层，另带运行时别名层，旧 id 建的会话仍可解析。
